reviews.text: Great home workout. R

Great app, needs improvement though.. Long-time daily user for years now. Some things need improvement, however, For me, the most important thing is that the camera angles for poses must differ from what you've provided. You've got to be showing the poses from angles that make sense, particularly in the Beginner program. On Day 5, the Crow pose day, you start with a Tree pose, only showing the person from the side so we can't see what he's doing with his leg, and the very next pose only shows him from the waist up, so we can't at any time see his leg position. Why you would do this is utterly baffling. This sort of thing occurs at other points throughout the Beginner program as well. Also, starting the very first course of the Beginner program - Day 1 - with palm-lifted pushups is nuts, that should be later down the line. If you want to discourage new users, that's how to do it. Overall, using the app has been a great experience, and near-daily use for the past two-plus years has been transformational. Please consider updating the camera angles for clear demonstrations of the poses, consider showing and describing modifications, and keep up the excellent work.

reviews.text: Wonderful strengthening. Hi this is Patrick and skill yoga is a wonderful opportunity to stretch, relax, strengthening your body to check in with yourself. I love skill yoga because it helps me get ready for the day and get in shape all at the same time.

LOVE the app, Missing something…. First of all, I love the app. I love the variety of programs and the simple and straightforward shooting style. Out of all the yoga apps I looked into, this is the one that I decided to subscribe to (and I’m glad I did). One feature the app is missing, for subscribers, is a plan. You have “programs,” but the most videos in a program is 7 (from what I’ve seen so far). That’s great, but what do I do after week 1? What’s my next step? I can browse the library, but I think for most people, they need the next step ready to go before their current plan dries up. Should I repeat the same program? Should I try a new one? For me, that uncertainty causes me to lose motivation. The biggest way I stay motivated for working out is having a plan and staying consistent with that plan. What I would love to see is some sort of AI looking at my goals, feedback from workouts, etc., and telling me what my monthly schedule is, so that I know, “Okay, I have four yoga workouts planned for this week, and I can see what they are, and I even know what I’m doing next week, and the week after, and the week after.” Something that takes the great workouts you’ve already developed and maps them to my schedule, and continuously keeps them coming. Other than that, I think the app is great overall and I’m a happy customer!

reviews.text: Great app!. Even though I have yet to subscribe the few workouts they let you do for free are amazing and challenging for beginners! I’ll be looking forward to my subscription soon!

Best so far!. There are some great yoga teachers out there for instance I started with “Yoga with Adrienne,” and then found Sean Vigue. I love them both, for different reasons, and I still consider them part of my suite of teachers. But Skill Yoga is a perfect program, tailored to my needs (I’m a 59-year-old beginner), that moves at the right pace, challenges me without killing me, and, while I love Sean and Adrienne, Skill Yoga kindly leaves most of the “personality” behind, so that I can focus on the training repeatedly every day. Love it!

Great yoga workouts I’ve lost 55 llbs while using this app!. I was looking for a home workout and couldn’t be happier with this yoga program, the instruction is very calm and instructive and the instructor in the videos demonstrates most things really well there are some limitations, but let’s me honest a video workout is always gonna have a few drawbacks but this series is about as good as it gets. The real selling point is if you like me don’t love the yoga instruction that’s all breathy and talking about “envisioning yourself on a island” then this app is for you. The instruction focuses you on your breath and the feeling of stress/stretch on your muscles 

The workouts scale well and once you get more advanced you’ll see how the basics build into more advanced movements and I’ve found myself surprised I can do some advanced movements with ease. The only other nit picks I’ve found is the ratings for the workouts leave a little to be desired and I get when a trainer counts down then makes you do a couple extra reps but when your watching the same videos on repeat and you know it’s coming it just gets hung up in my brain that it’s coming and makes me so mad for some reason. Obviously those are some pretty specific nitpicks and I’ve lost about 55llbs in the last year so can’t argue with the results!

I’ve been doing the “beginner” videos for the past few weeks and I couldn’t be happier with this app. I always feel so good, rested, and sore (in a good way!) after each session. The sessions are perfect and just challenging enough to keep me on my toes (literally).

Skill Yoga Review. For the 20’s Male athlete trying to retain mobility and flexibility: this is the app for you. Short, but very challenging sessions that can fill in for a lift if desired. Challenging but AMAZING. Hands down the best yoga app I’ve seen. I look forward to my training every night and love seeing the progress I’m making with the help of the skilled coaches and their workouts. The Shavasana at the end is the perfect way to round out the workout and really helps you connect with your body, both physically and mentally (as does the whole program, honestly). 

The only advice I would give is to start with the Beginner level. Being a personal trainer and self-proclaimed gym rat, I assumed I’d be fine skipping the Beginner level and going straight to Advanced. I paid dearly for that in the beginning as the workouts are challenging in a different and refreshing way. 

All in all, this is a perfect app for all yoga levels, and is very highly recommended.

reviews.text:
Great app, but a few creases that could be ironed out. As someone who is new to yoga, I’ve found this very helpful and an enjoyable way to get used to building flexibility and strength. You are encouraged to go at a pace that is right for you and I’ve been able to do things I never thought I could!

I’ve enjoyed it so much that I will be resubscribing! However there are a few things that could make the app even better:

1. Why are all the instructors men? What is this? Broga?

2. Sometimes the narrator gets things wrong. Sometimes they’ll say “left” when the mean “right”, sometimes they’ll say “one more round” and then you end up doing two more rounds, sometimes they’ll be instructing you through some reps and half way through give a big pause, then go through the rest of the reps really fast in a way that is too hard to keep up.

3. The early videos are crap and they should just be deleted/remade

4. It would be good if there were more video examples of particular exercises/holds in the routines so you can see what you will be doing before you start

5. If you’re halfway through a programme, you can’t skip a session if it’s too hard. For example, my balance isn’t great, and the HIT leg class I cannot do at all even with the easier options despite having strong legs as a runner.

I hope you this feedback can be taken on board as it will make the app perfect!

Customer service said no and that they physically could not do it as their payment provider wouldn’t allow it. I’ve never known a merchant to refuse giving customers refunds. Anyway, they offer a 14 day money back guarantee for your first 14 days so how can they issue a refund for that? I wouldn’t have cared if they obviously weren’t lying to me and pretending to be empathetic at that same time. 

The majority of companies would offer a refund as they realise sometimes people might forget what they are automatically subbed to on a yearly basis on an app they haven’t used in months. 

Stay away from this company. They clearly don’t care about their customers and only want to line their pockets. It’s probably why they don’t do the subs through the App Store - so you can’t see or remember you’re subbed to them. Parasites, leaches, scum, whatever you want to call them.
